name: Perfect Scrambled Eggs
description: Creamy, soft scrambled eggs cooked low and slow for the best texture.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons heavy cream or crème fraîche
Salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.title: Crack and whisk the eggs
steps.instruction: Crack 4 eggs into a bowl. Add a pinch of salt and whisk until the yolks and whites are fully combined. Don't add the cream yet.

steps.title: Start low and slow
steps.instruction: Put a non-stick pan over low heat and add the butter. Once it's melted and foamy, pour in the eggs. The key is low heat — don't rush this.

steps.title: Stir constantly
steps.instruction: Using a rubber spatula, stir the eggs continuously in slow figures of 8, scraping the bottom and sides. You want small, soft curds forming gradually over 5-6 minutes.

steps.title: Pull off heat when almost done
steps.instruction: When the eggs look 80% set but still glossy and slightly underdone, take the pan off the heat. Stir in the cream — this stops the cooking and makes them silky.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.instruction: Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately on warm toast, topped with chives or herbs if you like.
